title: ARIRANG World Tour Closes Two-Night AT&T Stadium Run in Arlington
detail: August 16, 2026 — BTS closed its sold-out two-night stand at AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas with a 25-song set that varied from Night 1: 'Butterfly' and 'The Most Beautiful Moment in Life Pt. 2' replaced 'Others' and 'Permission to Dance' in the main set, per setlist.fm, while the encore again closed with 'Come Over,' 'Butter,' 'Dynamite,' 'DNA,' 'Please,' and 'Into the Sun.' The stand capped a weekend that drew fans from Nebraska, Alabama, and beyond despite 101°F heat and ticket prices fans called 'an arm and a leg.' The ARIRANG World Tour now heads to Rogers Stadium in Toronto (Aug 22-23) — BTS's first Canadian shows since 2018 — followed by two nights at Chicago's Soldier Field (Aug 27-28).

media.caption: BTS closes a sold-out two-night run at AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas.
